memory_update.text: Defense subtier visibility is a high-value funnel node because public evidence from CNAS indicates DoD and primes have limited visibility beyond tier two, creating room for underfollowed suppliers several layers below headline primes.

MRCY should remain in the underfollowed lane as a trusted defense-electronics and secure-processing supplier; next layer should test backlog quality, margin conversion, program concentration, and organic growth.

summary: Expanded the defense subtier-supplier node with a two-lane universe: one context/reference niche supplier and three underfollowed discovery candidates tied to defense electronics, aerospace structures, controls, and specialty materials. The strongest shared chokepoint logic is that defense spending and multiyear procurement only convert into output if qualified lower-tier suppliers can deliver certified components, electronics, alloys, and actuation/control systems. Candidate inclusion is research-only and not a buy/sell recommendation.
